summary: Frontend-only verification of Google Maps location fix. iframe [data-testid='location-map'] src = https://www.google.com/maps/embed/v1/place?key=...&q=37.680861,24.334278&zoom=15. Contains q=37.680861,24.334278 and zoom=15. Coordinates verified mathematically against DMS 37°40'51.1"N 24°20'03.4"E. Iframe visible (552x482 at 1920x1080), map tiles render with red pin on small peninsula on Kea coastline near Gronisi/Villa Litharia (Otzias/Kephala area). No console errors, no Google API key errors in iframe.
critical_code_review_comments: Google Maps embed API key is hardcoded in App.js (it is Google's widely-used public sample key AIzaSyBFw0...). Works now, but consider a project-owned key via env var (REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY) or keyless embed (https://maps.google.com/maps?q=37.680861,24.334278&z=15&output=embed) for long-term reliability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map iframe in LocationSection (App.js ~line 1193) verified pointing to 37.680861,24.334278 zoom 15. Previous iteration_2 covered the rest of the site.
